```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(adespatial)
library(ecotraj)
library(ade4)
library(ape)
library(tibble)
library(iNEXT)
library(patchwork)
library(measurements)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
traits_uk <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_United_Kingdom.csv")|> 
  select(country, class:genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume)|> 
  mutate(biovolume = as.numeric(biovolume))

traits_med <- read.csv2("data/PhytoplanktonTraits_Mediterranean_BlackSea_CoastalLagoons_v1.2.csv") |> 
  select(country, class, family, order, genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume) |> 
  mutate(shape = tolower(shape)) |> 
  mutate(biovolume = as.numeric(biovolume))

traits_bs <- read.csv("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Turkey.csv",dec = ".",sep = ";") |> 
  select(country, class:genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume)

traits_au <- read.csv("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Australia.csv",dec = ".",sep = ";") |> 
  select(country, class:genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume)

traits_br <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton__Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Brasil.csv") |> 
  select(country, class:genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume) |> 
  mutate(biovolume = as.numeric(biovolume))

traits_mv <- read.csv2("data/Phytoplankton_Progetto_Strategico_2009_2012_Maldives.csv")|> 
  select(country, class:genus, scientificName, shape, biovolume)|> 
  mutate(biovolume = as.numeric(biovolume))

tt <- traits_uk |>
  bind_rows(traits_med) |>
  bind_rows(traits_br) |> 
  bind_rows(traits_bs) |>
  bind_rows(traits_au) |> 
  bind_rows(traits_mv) |> 
  filter(class == "Bacillariophyceae")

```

```{r}


qt <- data.frame()
for (ctry in unique(tt$country)) {
  data <- tt |> filter(country == ctry)
  
  qt <- qt |>  
    bind_rows(as.data.frame(t(quantile(data$biovolume, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
                mutate(country = ctry) |>
                select(country, everything())) 
  qt
}

  quantile(tt$biovolume, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(tt, aes(x = biovolume)) +
    geom_histogram(na.rm = TRUE, bins = 3)+
    # scale_x_log10()+
  facet_wrap(facets = ~country)
```
